description: Expected move-outs and year-1 cost of raising below-market rents to market, under Custom Solutions' model from its Rental Property Portfolio Analyzer: the share of current tenants likely to leave, the make-ready cost per unit that turns over and the rent lost while those units sit empty. The figure is hard to estimate because move-outs rise with the size of the raise, with month-to-month tenancies and with the length of tenancy; the model's parameters are the firm's planning assumptions, listed in the answer. Send current_rent and market_rent per unit per month and units; optionally vacant_units, month_to_month_units and tenancy_years.

current_rent.description: Average rent current tenants pay per unit per month, e.g. 1050

market_rent.description: Market rent per unit per month, e.g. 1450

month_to_month_units.description: Tenanted units with no lease, e.g. 2

tenancy_years.description: Average years the current tenants have lived there, e.g. 9

name: compute_rent_raise_turnover
title: Rent-raise turnover
